stage0048_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「The Unknown moving underwater will soon
　enter range. The team including $c
　is already in position」

stage0048_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Whoever they may be,
　let's teach them how foolish it is
　to challenge the Danaan underwater」

stage0048_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Unknown confirmed...!
　It's UG」

stage0048_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Their movements... gradually,
　they're growing more active...」

stage0048_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「All the more reason we can't lose」

stage0048_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$c, signal all units to launch...!」

stage0048_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Only this many units could sortie...!?」

stage0048_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$エマ$$
「The hatch closed on us mid-launch...」

stage0048_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Is it some kind of trouble...?」

stage0048_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$タケル$$
「Since we can't reach the Danaan's
　command center, that's the only read」

stage0048_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シモン$$
「Then we fight with what we've got!」

stage0048_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$竜馬$$
「They're all underwater, huh...!
　This is gonna be a pain!」

stage0048_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Damn it!
　Isn't their aim to seize this ship!?」

stage0048_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Ah, I had that changed.
　To sink this ship instead」

stage0048_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I've heard how great this ship is.
　So then, let's see how much of
　their attack it can dodge」

stage0048_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This is the worst!
　Hand the helm to me right now!
　Release the helmsman and sonarman too!」

stage0048_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This is the brink of whether this ship sinks!
　Even I don't know if I can dodge it...!
　There's no way you possibly can!」

stage0048_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「You won't know until you try, right?」

stage0048_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Now... here comes the second shot...!
　If it works out, that'll be a laugh!」

stage0048_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Now, dodge it!
　Can you do it, I wonder?
　Or maybe you can't... ahahahaha!」

stage0048_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This ship will now cover $c
　and intercept the enemy force!」

stage0048_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$宗介$$ and an enemy AS!」

stage0048_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$宗介$$
「Give up, $$ガウルン$$!
　You're trapped now!」

stage0048_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「But no.
　I've still got a trump card to turn this around!」

stage0048_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Bluffing, at a time like this!?」

stage0048_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's not it.
　My AS is loaded with enough explosives
　to blow this ship away with ease」

stage0048_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$宗介$$
「You...!
　You mean to take $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ down with you!?」

stage0048_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Not just the ship, Kashim!
　You too!」

stage0048_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$宗介$$
「Damn it!
　What do I do!?」

stage0048_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't worry.
　Everything is gonna
　Happy!」

stage0048_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Sagara!
　Right now, $$かなめ$$ is one with the Danaan!
　The Danaan is like her own hands and feet!」

stage0048_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$宗介$$
「Alright...!
　Chidori, I'm counting on you!!」

stage0048_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I don't know what you're planning,
　but my finger's already on the trigger!
　You've got 30 seconds left!」

stage0048_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Or so I thought, but I changed my mind!
　Make that 10 seconds!」

stage0048_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「The enemy AS and the Arbalest
　are on the catapult!」

stage0048_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Now that's a surprise!
　So this is why you shoved me onto the catapult!」

stage0048_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Fine by me!
　You went to the trouble of setting the stage,
　so let's have some fun with it, Kashim!」

stage0048_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$宗介$$
「Just how far will you go...!」

stage0048_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Not yet! Your killing intent's still lacking!
　That won't reach the Kashim
　I love so much!」

stage0048_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$宗介$$...!
　Face who you are right now!
　You are you!」

stage0048_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Geez, quit playing the sensitive tough guy,
　you brooding sergeant!」

stage0048_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$マオ$$
「Quit stalling and crush that bastard already!」

stage0048_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$n
「$$宗介$$!
　You want to make it up to Chidori,
　don't you! So live and come back!」

stage0048_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$n
「That's your most important mission, isn't it!!」

stage0048_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Something's off, Kashim!
　I didn't want to see you cheered on by friends!」

stage0048_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$ガウルン$$... I'll kill you!」

stage0048_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I'm glad, Kashim!
　I don't know the logic behind it, but if
　you're fired up now, I've got no complaints!」

stage0048_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Now, let's enjoy this to the fullest!
　A rotten mudslinging match!」

stage0048_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$宗介$$
「That ends today!
　I'm sick of looking at your face!!」

stage0048_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Our damage was heavy as well,
　but we gained a great deal too」

stage0048_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「And the fact that they've joined hands with UG」

stage0048_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$宗介$$
「Kashim, Kashim, so familiar all of a sudden,
　you bastard!!」

stage0048_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Sorry for saying something so thoughtless.
　Now that I think about it, I...
　I still don't know anything about you）

stage0048_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$かなめ$$
（What an amazing guy...
　Honestly, I think you're cool, $$宗介$$...）

stage0048_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Well, that was fun enough, Kashim!」

stage0048_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$マオ$$
「Just like he said,
　he really had a ton of explosives
　loaded up. Went out with a bang」

stage0048_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$宗介$$
（$$ガウルン$$...
　Whatever you say, I'm $$相良宗介$$...）

stage0048_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This is priceless!
　Who'd have thought it'd end like this!」

stage0048_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't get in my way, you!
　I'll deal with you after Kashim,
　so sit tight and wait there!!」

stage0048_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$テッサ$$
「If the enemy's target is this Danaan,
　all the better. Let's teach them just how
　foolish and reckless a fight they picked」

stage0048_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「All hands, you heard her.
　Consider it a chance to vent our pent-up frustration」

stage0048_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$テッサ$$
（Alright, here we go, $$かなめ$$...!）

stage0048_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I've been waiting, Kashim!
　For this very moment!」

stage0048_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$宗介$$
「Same goes for me, $$ガウルン$$!」

stage0048_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「But you can't relax yet, Kashim!
　As long as doubt remains in you,
　who knows when you'll slide back to being useless!」

stage0048_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$宗介$$
「I've no reason to be told
　how to live my life by you!」

stage0048_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't be so cold, Kashim!
　Aren't we close, you and I?」

stage0048_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$宗介$$
「Shut up!
　I've no wish to hear another word from you!」

stage0048_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$n
「$$ヒイロ$$...
　Why do you care so much about $$宗介$$?」

stage0048_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$n
「...Fine.
　But I'm grateful for your help」

stage0048_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$n
「But more urgently,
　when $$宗介$$ and Chidori fight,
　it lands on me」

stage0048_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That man's in quite an enviable position」

stage0048_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$n
「Agreed.
　Now, let's clean up the enemy」
